questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a negative conditional structure?
options: Had she not studied, she would have failed the exam.
Only if you had practised more would you have passed.
Not until he realised the mistake did he correct it.
Unless she had been warned, she would have been in danger.
questions.answer: Only if you had practised more would you have passed.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence best expresses the idea that ‘the most important factor in success is hard work’?
options: What matters most is hard work, according to the research.
Hard work is what success is all about.
It is hard work that determines success, not luck.
The success of the project was largely due to hard work.
questions.answer: What matters most is hard work, according to the research.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive to express a hypothetical scenario involving a hypothetical situation?
options: If she were to win the prize, she would donate it to charity.
If she wins the prize, she will donate it to charity.
She wishes she had won the prize, but she won’t donate it.
She would donate the prize if she won it, but she didn’t.
questions.answer: If she were to win the prize, she would donate it to charity.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis effectively to avoid repetition while maintaining formal clarity?
options: The committee met, discussed the proposal, and voted—all in one afternoon.
After reviewing the report, we concluded that the project needed revision.
She finished her thesis, defended it, and secured the PhD in record time.
He arrived late, apologised, and left without explaining his absence.
questions.answer: The committee met, discussed the proposal, and voted—all in one afternoon.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates the use of a formal register with passive voice and a nuanced choice of verb form?
options: The decision was taken by the board to delay the project.
The board decided to delay the project, which caused delays.
The project’s delay was announced by the company’s CEO last week.
They announced that the project would be delayed because of budget issues.
questions.answer: The decision was taken by the board to delay the project.
